nuggets.text: Catamounts coach Kerwin Bell walked on at Florida and became the SEC Player of the Year in 1984.
Kerwin Bell led Valdosta State to a 14-0 season and the 2018 Division II title, winning the final 49-47.
Lex Thomas threw three touchdown passes in the third quarter alone of the Catamounts' 45-21 opening win over Eastern Kentucky.
Catamounts QB Lex Thomas attempted just 15 passes in his first two years at NC State before transferring.
The Catamounts' opener drew 13,482 fans, the 10th-largest crowd in E.J. Whitmire Stadium history.
The Catamounts' Pride of the Mountains band began with 23 students in 1938 and now has almost 500 members.
The Pride of the Mountains, the Catamounts' marching band, was the lead band in the 2014 Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.
The Catamounts' rivalry trophy with East Tennessee State is a rock from the Appalachian Trail.
The Catamounts' game at Campbell was pushed back a day after lightning and a failed stadium light bank.
The Catamounts reached the 1983 Division I-AA national title game after beating Colgate, Holy Cross and Furman.
